We need to determine charges based on fact. The fact: Defendant was ordered to pay compensation, failed to comply with execution notice, didn't report assets, was judicially detained, later complied and got forgiveness, case closed.

Potential charge: "拒不执行判决、裁定" (refusal to execute judgment). Also maybe "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件"? No. The fact is about refusing to execute a civil judgment, which is a criminal offense under Chinese law: "拒不执行判决、裁定". So charge is that.

Any other? He was judicially detained (maybe for that offense). He later complied, got forgiveness. No other listed crimes like fraud, etc.

Thus answer: [罪名]拒不执行判决、裁定<eoa>
